title: Chimera — starter routes
description: All ten source combos across Mirror, Apprentice and Gazelle, expanded into explicit variants for alternative openings, draw-effect responses and the Azamina/S:P branch. Instructions are independently written from the procedural sequences and checked against installed card text. Notes correct resource-count and GY/banished-zone ambiguities. These teaching routes are not executable replays or guaranteed boards through every interruption.
author: MDPro4 examples · source: Drident

combos.title: Mirror + a discard: Hecahands finish
combos.description: Start with Mirror Swordknight and one expendable card. This route uses your Normal Summon. Keep the Hecahands package in the Deck/Extra Deck. Big-Winged Berfomet restricts later Extra Deck summons to Fusion Monsters. Chimera's hand reduction resolves in the End Phase.

cardNotes.start:28954097: Plus one expendable card. Coatl can search Mirror before this line; keep the separate discard available.
cardNotes.end:1769875: Field; hand reduction during your End Phase.
cardNotes.end:28954097: Field; can banish itself from field or GY to negate an on-field monster effect while the required Chimera name is present.
cardNotes.end:29792472: Set; requires the appropriate Hecahands board.
cardNotes.around:92248362: The early effects use field/GY locations. This is a route consideration, not immunity to every timing.

steps.title: Open the Chimera engine
steps.text: Normal Summon Mirror. Tribute it to Special Summon Big-Winged Berfomet from the Deck.

steps.title: Collect the Fusion pieces
steps.text: Use Big-Winged Berfomet to add Gazelle and Chimera Fusion.

steps.title: Make the first Fusion
steps.text: Activate Chimera Fusion using Big-Winged Berfomet and Gazelle to Fusion Summon Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts.

steps.title: Resolve the material triggers
steps.text: A possible order is Gazelle CL1, Big-Winged Berfomet CL2 targeting Mirror, and Chimera CL3. Revive Mirror; add Nightmare Apprentice with Gazelle. Chimera schedules its End Phase hand reduction.

steps.title: Recover the Quick-Play Spell
steps.text: Return Chimera Fusion from the GY to your hand while the required Chimera name is present.

steps.title: Bridge to Hecahands
steps.text: Discard the spare card to Special Summon Nightmare Apprentice. Its search adds Hecahands Mankibuel.

steps.title: Summon Jauzah
steps.text: Reveal Mankibuel in hand and use it with Apprentice on the field to Fusion Summon Hecahands Jauzah.

steps.title: Prepare the response
steps.text: Use Jauzah to add Yad'al-Hecahands. Set it and Chimera Fusion. Keep Mirror available for the opponent's turn.

combos.title: Mirror: compact line into Maxx "C"
combos.description: A response after the opponent chains Maxx "C" to Mirror. This line gives two draws and schedules one End Phase hand reduction; it does not claim that Maxx "C" draws only once.

cardNotes.end:28954097: GY; a monster-effect negate only while the required Chimera name is present.
cardNotes.end:92565383: GY; response to an effect targeting your cards.

steps.title: Commit Mirror
steps.text: Normal Summon Mirror and activate its tribute effect. If Maxx "C" is chained, it resolves before Mirror summons Big-Winged Berfomet.

steps.title: Collect the Fusion pair
steps.text: Resolve Big-Winged Berfomet to add Gazelle and Chimera Fusion. Accept its Fusion-only Extra Deck restriction.

steps.title: Establish the Chimera name
steps.text: Fusion Summon Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts using Gazelle and Big-Winged Berfomet.

steps.title: Take the low-summon branch
steps.text: Activate Gazelle to search Cornfield Coatl and Chimera to schedule its End Phase hand reduction. Do not activate Big-Winged Berfomet to revive Mirror in the Maxx "C" branch.

steps.title: Prepare the next Fusion
steps.text: Discard Coatl to search another Gazelle. Mirror and Coatl now remain in the GY, with their conditions supported by Chimera.

steps.title: Recover and set the Spell
steps.text: Recover Chimera Fusion using its GY effect, then set it. The opponent drew for two Special Summons if Maxx "C" resolved before Berfomet; Chimera removes one random hand card in the End Phase if its effect resolved.

combos.title: Mirror: Fuwalos revival variant
combos.description: If the draw effect is Mulcharmy Fuwalos rather than Maxx "C", reviving Mirror from the GY does not trigger another Fuwalos draw. Keep the first two summons and the End Phase hand reduction distinct.

cardNotes.end:28954097: Field; can banish itself from field or GY to negate an on-field monster effect while the required Chimera name is present.
cardNotes.end:92565383: GY; response to an effect targeting your cards.

steps.title: Respond to Fuwalos
steps.text: Normal Summon Mirror. After Fuwalos resolves, tribute Mirror to summon Big-Winged Berfomet from the Deck.

steps.title: Collect the Fusion pair
steps.text: Resolve Big-Winged Berfomet to add Gazelle and Chimera Fusion. Accept its Fusion-only Extra Deck restriction.

steps.title: Establish the Chimera name
steps.text: Fusion Summon Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts using Gazelle and Big-Winged Berfomet.

steps.title: Include the GY revival
steps.text: Use Gazelle to add Coatl, Big-Winged Berfomet to revive Mirror, and Chimera to schedule its hand reduction. The GY summon is outside Fuwalos's Deck/Extra Deck draw condition.

steps.title: Keep the second protection
steps.text: Discard Coatl to add Gazelle. Mirror remains on the field and Coatl remains in the GY.

steps.title: Set the follow-up
steps.text: Recover and set Chimera Fusion. Two Deck/Extra Deck summons triggered Fuwalos; the GY revival did not. Resolve Chimera's scheduled hand reduction in the End Phase.

combos.title: Mirror + material + discard: Fiendsmith
combos.description: Requires Mirror, an additional Illusion/Fiend material, and a separate discard. Complete all Link and Xyz summons before resolving Big-Winged Berfomet's search. The final Princess draw is an unknown card.

cardNotes.end:1769875: Field; schedules one End Phase hand reduction.
cardNotes.end:28954097: Field; can banish itself from field or GY to negate an on-field monster effect while the required Chimera name is present.
cardNotes.end:63136489: Set; the copy recovered before the second Fusion.
cardNotes.end:4731783: Returns during the End Phase; its next effect still requires a discard.
cardNotes.end:79559912: Field, initially with two Xyz Materials.

steps.title: Start with Gazelle instead
steps.text: Normal Summon Mirror and tribute it to summon Gazelle from the Deck. Gazelle searches Chimera Fusion; Big-Winged Berfomet is deliberately delayed until after the Link/Xyz portion.

steps.title: Use the extra material
steps.text: Fuse Gazelle with the opening Illusion or Fiend from hand into Berfomet the Mythical King of Phantom Beasts.

steps.title: Split the material triggers
steps.text: Use Gazelle's Fusion-material trigger to add Nightmare Apprentice and Fusion Berfomet's summon trigger to send Sinister Necrom.

steps.title: Bank the spare Spell
steps.text: Recover Chimera Fusion from the GY while Fusion Berfomet supplies the required Chimera name. Keep this copy for the final set.

steps.title: Reach the Fiendsmith engine
steps.text: Banish Sinister Necrom from the GY to summon Adusted Gold. Link Gold into Requiem; tribute Requiem to summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears. Use Tears to send Engraver from the Deck to the GY.

steps.title: Make the equipped-material summon
steps.text: Equip Requiem from the GY to Lacrima the Crimson Tears. Send Tears and its Fiend Equip Card to the GY for Necroquip Princess's own Special Summon procedure.

steps.title: Deploy Apprentice
steps.text: Discard the spare opening card to Special Summon Nightmare Apprentice, then search Cornfield Coatl.

steps.title: Draw before overlaying Princess
steps.text: Discard Coatl to search Big-Winged Berfomet. Because a monster was sent from hand to the GY as an activation cost while Necroquip Princess is still present, use Princess to draw one card. The draw is an unknown card, not a generated Upstart Goblin.

steps.title: Overlay the Level 6 Fiends
steps.text: Use Fusion Berfomet and Necroquip Princess as the two Level 6 Fiend materials for D/D/D Wave High King Caesar.

steps.title: Recover Engraver
steps.text: Use Engraver in the GY, shuffling Adusted Gold into the Deck as the other LIGHT Fiend, then Special Summon Engraver.

steps.title: Make Sequence
steps.text: Link Apprentice and Engraver into Fiendsmith's Sequence.

steps.title: Fuse from the GY
steps.text: Use Sequence to shuffle Lacrima the Crimson Tears and Requiem from the GY into their respective decks, Fusion Summoning Fiendsmith's Lacrima. Its Fusion trigger revives Engraver.

steps.title: Build the Link-4
steps.text: Link Sequence, Fusion Lacrima and Engraver into A Bao A Qu, counting Sequence as Link-2. Fusion Lacrima can then shuffle Sequence from the GY into the Extra Deck to inflict 1200 damage.

steps.title: Revive the discarded searcher
steps.text: Use A Bao A Qu: discard Big-Winged Berfomet, temporarily banish A Bao, then revive that Berfomet. Search a second Gazelle and another Chimera Fusion. Its Fusion-only Extra Deck lock begins now.

steps.title: Make the final Chimera
steps.text: Use the newly searched Chimera Fusion to fuse Big-Winged Berfomet and Gazelle into Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts. Gazelle's material search was already used earlier this turn.

steps.title: Restore Mirror
steps.text: Use Big-Winged Berfomet's material trigger to revive Mirror, and Chimera's Fusion trigger to schedule its End Phase hand reduction.

steps.title: Keep the unused copy
steps.text: Set the Chimera Fusion recovered earlier. Its once-per-turn GY recovery was already used; do not recover another copy again this turn.

steps.title: Resolve the End Phase
steps.text: Return A Bao A Qu from its temporary banishment and resolve Chimera's scheduled random hand reduction. Maintain free Monster Zones for the returning Link Monster.

combos.title: Apprentice interrupted: Moon into Caesar
combos.description: Use this alternate route only while Apprentice remains on the field after its search was negated or Droll resolved. You need another Effect Monster in hand that can be Normal Summoned without tribute, and an unused Normal Summon. This fallback ends at Caesar; it does not promise the full Chimera board.

cardNotes.start:58143852: Also requires one tribute-free Normal Summonable Effect Monster; Apprentice must still be on the field.
cardNotes.end:79559912: Reduced fallback board, initially two materials.
cardNotes.around:94145021: After Droll resolves, skip all forbidden searches. The full Chimera/Hecahands/A Bao finish is not promised; use only resources already accessible.

steps.title: Supply the second body
steps.text: Normal Summon your additional Effect Monster. Use it and Apprentice to Link Summon Moon of the Closed Heaven.

steps.title: Use the LIGHT Fiend link
steps.text: Link Moon into Requiem. Tribute Requiem to summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears and send Engraver with Tears. These effects do not add a card from the Deck to hand.

steps.title: Revive Engraver without a search
steps.text: Shuffle Moon from the GY into the Extra Deck for Engraver's GY effect and summon Engraver.

steps.title: Build the Fusion link
steps.text: Link Tears and Engraver into Sequence.

steps.title: Fuse the LIGHT materials
steps.text: Sequence shuffles Tears and Requiem from the GY to Fusion Summon Fiendsmith's Lacrima. Use its Fusion trigger to Special Summon Engraver, rather than adding it to hand.

steps.title: Overlay the two Level 6 monsters
steps.text: Xyz Summon Caesar using Fusion Lacrima and Engraver. Sequence may remain on the field. Respect any additional effect that caused the original interruption.

steps.title: Fusion Summon Chimera

steps.title: Recover a body and search the extender

steps.title: Recover Chimera Fusion
steps.text: Return Chimera Fusion from the GY to the hand.

steps.title: Finish the Hecahands package

combos.title: Gazelle + material: compact Maxx "C" line
combos.description: Requires Gazelle and an additional Illusion or Fiend in hand. Search Chimera Fusion, make one Fusion Summon, and keep the later interaction in the GY. This is not a guarantee against every interruption.

cardNotes.start:23076639: Also need an Illusion/Fiend, or Chimera Fusion to search that material.
cardNotes.around:27204311: This short uninterrupted line stays below five summons; account for any earlier summons this turn.

steps.title: Choose the compact Fusion

steps.title: Recover the next Fusion

steps.title: Pass with resources

combos.title: Gazelle + Coatl: Azamina bridge
combos.description: Expanded from the source's compressed four-step route. It requires a discard for A Bao and another send resource for optional Diabellstar. The source's nine-card end display mixes field, GY and future summons; the annotations identify each. The base Link-4 consumes Caesar.

cardNotes.start:23076639: Also Coatl, one available discard for A Bao and a separate send-to-GY resource if using Diabellstar.
cardNotes.end:11321089: Later Fusion option, not a monster already on the field. Needs three differently named materials from hand and field.
cardNotes.end:22850702: GY in the base route. Berfomet cannot revive it from the GY.
cardNotes.end:69601012: GY; its opponent-turn effect targets a banished eligible monster.
cardNotes.end:92565383: GY if you used the corrected Coatl opener.
cardNotes.end:46174776: Field after Big-Winged Berfomet revives it.
cardNotes.end:1769875: Field; scheduled End Phase hand reduction.
cardNotes.around:27204311: An early tribute can remove Caesar or its materials. Continuation depends on the remaining hand and timing; do not assume the full ending survives.

steps.title: Correct the opening hand
steps.text: Start with Gazelle and Coatl. Discard Coatl to add Mirror. Starting with Gazelle and Mirror directly also reaches the engine, but does not place Coatl in the GY for its protection.

steps.title: Load the Azamina bridge
steps.text: Normal Summon Gazelle to search Chimera Fusion, then fuse Gazelle and Mirror into Fusion Berfomet. Gazelle's material trigger adds Elzette and Berfomet sends Sinister Necrom.

steps.title: Reach the Fiendsmith engine
steps.text: Banish Sinister Necrom from the GY to summon Adusted Gold. Link Gold into Requiem; tribute Requiem to summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears. Use Tears to send Engraver from the Deck to the GY.

steps.title: Recover Engraver
steps.text: Use Engraver in the GY, shuffling Adusted Gold into the Deck as the other LIGHT Fiend, then Special Summon Engraver.

steps.title: Build the Fiendsmith Fusion
steps.text: Link Tears and Engraver into Sequence. Sequence shuffles Tears and Requiem from the GY to Fusion Summon Fiendsmith's Lacrima, whose trigger revives Engraver. Adusted Gold was already returned to the Deck for Engraver's earlier revival.

steps.title: Make Caesar for now
steps.text: Overlay Fusion Lacrima and Engraver for Caesar. Sequence and Fusion Berfomet remain on the field. Caesar will be consumed for A Bao in the base route unless extra material is supplied.

steps.title: Summon Elzette and fuse
steps.text: Reveal Elzette to Special Summon itself. Use its Fusion effect with Fusion Berfomet to summon Moa Regina.

steps.title: Make Chaos Angel
steps.text: Moa Regina revives Elzette. Synchro Summon Chaos Angel using Level 8 Moa and Level 2 Elzette, treating a LIGHT/DARK monster as a Tuner under Angel's procedure. Elzette searches Deception of the Sinful Spoils.

steps.title: Trade Angel for Hallowed
steps.text: Activate Deception and tribute Chaos Angel to search The Hallowed Azamina. Activate Hallowed, send the face-up Deception to the GY, and summon Mu Rcielago.

steps.title: Search the Quick-Play resource
steps.text: Use Mu Rcielago's Fusion trigger to add WANTED. Keep it available for the next Hallowed activation.

steps.title: Account for the Link materials
steps.text: At this point the base route has Sequence, Caesar and Mu Rcielago. Use all three for A Bao A Qu, counting Sequence as Link-2. This consumes Caesar: the base route cannot retain the Caesar icon shown in the source endboard without another body.

steps.title: Recover Hallowed
steps.text: Use Hallowed's GY effect, shuffling Mu Rcielago from the GY into the Extra Deck, to recover Hallowed.

steps.title: Chain WANTED to Hallowed
steps.text: Activate Hallowed revealing Ilia Silvia, then chain WANTED. WANTED adds Diabellstar; while the chain is still resolving its Spell Card remains available in the Spell & Trap Zone. Send it for Hallowed's resolution to summon Silvia.

steps.title: Revive Mirror before the Fusion lock
steps.text: Discard an available card for A Bao, temporarily banish it, and revive Mirror. Tribute Mirror for Big-Winged Berfomet; search Gazelle and another Chimera Fusion. All Link/Synchro/Xyz work must already be complete.

steps.title: Make the final Chimera
steps.text: Use the newly searched Chimera Fusion to fuse Big-Winged Berfomet and Gazelle into Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts. Gazelle's material search was already used earlier this turn.

steps.title: Restore Moa Regina
steps.text: Use Big-Winged Berfomet's material trigger to revive Moa Regina. Chimera's Fusion trigger schedules the hand reduction. Mirror, Coatl and Fusion Berfomet remain available in the GY.

steps.title: Recover the unused Fusion resource
steps.text: Use Chimera Fusion's GY effect once this turn to recover one copy, then set it. You need additional suitable hand and field material if you plan Guardian Chimera later.

steps.title: Use the remaining Sinful Spoils resources
steps.text: Banish WANTED from the GY to put Deception on the bottom of the Deck and draw one card. If Diabellstar is still available, pay its separate send-to-GY cost to summon it and set Deception from the Deck. Moa can respond to the relevant Sinful Spoils activation when legal.

steps.title: Resolve the End Phase
steps.text: Return A Bao A Qu from its temporary banishment and resolve Chimera's scheduled random hand reduction. Maintain free Monster Zones for the returning Link Monster.

steps.title: Distinguish later responses
steps.text: Guardian Chimera is an opponent-turn Fusion option requiring three differently named materials with at least one from hand and one from field. Fusion Berfomet can revive a banished Chaos Angel, not an Angel merely in the GY. In this base route Angel was tributed to the GY; A Bao may instead revive it on a later turn with a new discard.
